title: Arsuña Ukax Jaqi
intro: Mä chimpux qullan sarnaqäwit mistu, milagronak apt’ata, ukax orden natural ukar jan yäqasa. Aka almax mä sapa divin kamachi tuqiw purintäna, mä awk taykar jach’a juchañchawinakat arxatäna, ukat aka pachat sarxarakïna janïr aka uraqin cadenanakampi chint’atäkipana. Uka sarnaqäwix mä jisk’a cuna ukhat alaxpachar puriñkamaw uñt’ayasi. ¿Khitis akajj utjaspa?
clues: Nayax mä chimpu ukhamarak khuyapayasiñaw Allah tuqit Israel wawanakar khithatäta.
Nayan puritajajj janiw nayrjamäkänti — Diosan ‘¡Jeqtʼam!’ siski uka arumpiw uñstawayta. jan aka uraqinkir awkini.
Awk taykajajj jan sinttʼasisaw kʼarinak parläna, ukampis qollan revelacionaw saraqanïna, ukhamat jan juchanïpjjatap yatiyañataki ukat estacionapar jachʼañchañataki.
Jichhak nasit wawatpachjja, awk taykajan sutip qʼomachañatakejj cunajat qhan parlasaw jakʼankirinakarojj muspharayäta.
Allahan permisoparjamajja, jan jakkir laqʼatwa jakañ lurawayta, juykhunakarus uñjaraktwa, ukat llamktʼatajampiw lepra usun jaqerojj qollawayta.
Nayax alaxpacharuw sartayatätxa janïr jan walinakax llamkt’kitu ukhakama, ukat qhipa Hora janïr purinkipanx aka pacharuw kutt’ä.

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
verse: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water. (23:50)
